name: speech
description: Generate local speech with Kokoro and recognize recorded speech with Whisper.

interface.longDescription:
Create spoken audio from text and transcribe recorded speech locally.

Choose Kokoro voices and languages for narration, or use Whisper for transcripts, English translations and timed subtitles.

Requires Apple silicon, an existing MLX speech environment and downloaded models; Whisper also needs ffmpeg. No cloud speech service, voice cloning or speaker identification.
defaultPrompt: Say ‘Hello, this is a local speech sample’ using Sarah and save a new WAV file.
Transcribe the audio file I provided and save a new transcript with timestamps.
